fig-13-the-rule-and.text: Parker asked whether libghostty-vt is actually Ghostty. From the research: yes. It is Ghostty's own terminal core (parser, screen, scrollback, reflow, Kitty picture storage, key and mouse encoders), maintained inside ghostty-org/ghostty with Mitchell Hashimoto leading; building it clones Ghostty's source at a pinned commit and compiles it with Zig. Ghostty's renderer, fonts and app do not come with it, and the Rust bindings over it are third-party (Uzaaft/libghostty-rs). On the popularity pull, crates.io downloads: libghostty-vt bindings 131,640, rio-vt 70,499, wezterm-term unpublished (a fork has 11,430). (Assembling agent)
